def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Recolor solid rectangular patches of the dominant fill color to 4.
    # Find connected components of identical cells; target large rectangular components.
    seen=set()
    for y in range(h):
      for x in range(w):
        col=grid[y][x]
        if col not in (1,2,8) or (y,x) in seen: continue
        stack=[(y,x)]; seen.add((y,x)); comp=[]
        while stack:
          a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
          for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            n,m=a+da,b+db
            if 0<=n<h and 0<=m<w and (n,m) not in seen and grid[n][m]==col:
              seen.add((n,m)); stack.append((n,m))
        ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        area=(y1-y0+1)*(x1-x0+1)
        if area==len(comp) and (y1-y0+1)>=4 and (x1-x0+1)>=4:
          for a,b in comp: out[a][b]=4
    return out
